routes.title: PS4 7.00–9.60 · PSFree / Lapse
requirements: Open on the matching console browser and choose Start on the built-in loader page. Nothing runs when viewing the dashboard.
Native BIN listener: TCP 9020. Match this loader’s ABI; other payload transports are separate.
This PS4 bootstrap does not automatically load GoldHEN. Its raw BIN port 9020 is separate from GoldHEN HTTP port 9090 and ELF port 9021.
Static dependencies and file checksums verified. Console hardware execution has not been tested.

routes.title: PPPwn
requirements: Ethernet, Linux, Python3 and gcc. Configure the PS4 LAN connection as PPPoE. The original PoC only prints PPPwned; a compatible HEN stage2 is separate. This webpage does not perform PPPoE.

routes.title: pOOBs4 · 9.00
requirements: Requires a USB drive written with the project’s modified exFAT image. Follow the insertion/removal prompts. Its BIN listener uses TCP 9020; use a matching payload and sender. This is separate from the USB-free PSFree route.

notes: Selector options derive from exact route lists; an option is not universal payload compatibility.
